content.text:
I added the no-tools reminder. The summary instruction now ends with this line:

> REMINDER: Do NOT call any tools. Reply with the checkpoint text only; tool calls are discarded, and a reply without checkpoint text fails.

- **It's true to the code:** the summarizer keeps only text from the reply, and a reply with no text fails with "summarization produced no text summary content".
- **It's the last line** of the instruction, the spot the model pays most attention to, the same placement Claude Code uses.
- **Nothing else changed:** the system prompt, tool list and conversation are still sent word for word, so the provider cache is still reused.

I also updated the README copy of the instruction and the test that checks it matches. All 142 compaction-basic tests and lint pass.

It's pushed as branch `compaction-phase6`, tagged `compaction-v6`, stacked on the previous five phases. `main` still isn't merged, and the engine book still fails 4 documentation checks there.
